description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies the contract for a logging system component capable of outputting logs to one or more targets. It includes a single method, println, used to pass log data including severity level, tag, message, and optional exception information.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a logging node that can output log messages, possibly chaining to other LogNode instances.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception information.
